notes: Volt 0.0.2 (`ea522d7c`) This is the first Volt build you can download for macOS, Windows and Linux. It collects the work since the `0.0.1` tag: multi-agent tools, a code index for agents, design mode in the in-app browser, Git views for branches and worktrees, and a lot of speed work. ## Highlights - **Design mode in the in-app browser.** Click an element or drag an area and tell the agent what to change. A pick is named after its React or Vue component and goes with a picture of what you chose. **Batch edits** holds several annotations as numbered pins and sends them together. - **Subagents you can steer.** Resume a stopped subagent, retry a failed one, and see what each one changed in the turn's review. - **Plan mode with a plan card.** An agent proposes a plan you approve, revise, edit or save, and can carry it out in a new worktree chat. - **A code index for agents.** Volt indexes your open projects in the background, so `grep`, `glob`, `find_symbol` and `instant_grep` answer from an index. - **Several Claude accounts.** Switch by hand, or let Volt move to another account near a limit. - **Git views.** Branches, Remotes, Tags and Worktrees in Source Control, beside Commits and Stashes. - **Faster.** Near-instant chat switching, bounded chat memory, and a shorter loop for small requests. The full list is in the [changelog](https://github.com/LeulAria/volt/blob/v0.0.2/CHANGELOG.md#002---2026-10-18). ## Install | Your computer | Download | | --- | --- | | Mac with Apple silicon (M1 and newer) | `volt-stable-0.0.2-darwin-arm64.dmg` | | Mac with an Intel chip | `volt-stable-0.0.2-darwin-x64.dmg` | | Windows (x64, or Arm) | `volt-stable-0.0.2-win32--user-setup.exe` | | Linux | `volt-stable-0.0.2-linux-.deb`, `.rpm` or `.tar.gz` | ### Macs: read this first **The Mac build is not signed with an Apple Developer ID and is not notarized**, so macOS stops it the first time. That is expected, and it takes about a minute to get past: 1. Open the `.dmg`, drag **Volt** onto **Applications**, and open it. 2. macOS says **"Volt" Not Opened**. Click **Done**. 3. Open **System Settings > Privacy & Security**, scroll down to **Security**, and click **Open Anyway** next to *"Volt" was blocked to protect your Mac*. 4. In the *Open "Volt"?* dialog click **Open Anyway** (the blue button is *Move to Trash*, so do not press Return), then use Touch ID or your password. Volt opens, and it opens normally from then on. If you do not see **Open Anyway**, open Volt again first: the button shows for about an hour after a blocked attempt. Prefer the Terminal? Files downloaded with `curl` are not quarantined, so no dialog appears at all: ```bash curl -fL -o ~/Downloads/Volt.dmg https://github.com/LeulAria/volt/releases/download/v0.0.2/volt-stable-0.0.2-darwin-arm64.dmg # x64 on an Intel Mac hdiutil attach ~/Downloads/Volt.dmg -nobrowse -quiet && cp -R /Volumes/Volt/Volt.app /Applications/ && hdiutil detach /Volumes/Volt -quiet xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Volt.app # only if you downloaded it in a browser open -a Volt ``` To use Volt from the Terminal, run **Shell Command: Install 'volt' command in PATH** from the command palette, then `volt .` in any folder. The [macOS install guide](https://github.com/LeulAria/volt/blob/v0.0.2/docs/install/macos.md) has a screenshot for every step, the "Volt is damaged" fix, uninstall steps and troubleshooting. ### Windows and Linux The Windows installers are not code-signed either. When SmartScreen says **Windows protected your PC**, click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. On Linux, `sudo apt install ./volt-stable-0.0.2-linux-x64.deb` or `sudo dnf install ./volt-stable-0.0.2-linux-x64.rpm`. See the [install overview](https://github.com/LeulAria/volt/blob/v0.0.2/docs/install/README.md). ## Known limitations - On macOS, Volt cannot install updates by itself while it is unsigned. It tells you when a new version is out and opens the download. - macOS is the platform Volt is developed and tested on. Windows and Linux builds come from CI and have had little testing. - The agent server, web, mobile, Relay and Govern pieces are early and may change. Found a problem? [Open an issue](https://github.com/LeulAria/volt/issues/new/choose). For a security problem, follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/LeulAria/volt/blob/v0.0.2/SECURITY.md) instead of opening a public issue. **Downloads:** https://volt.leularia.com/download ## What's Changed * feat(accounts): several Claude logins, switched by hand or near a limit by @LeulAria in https://github.com/LeulAria/volt/pull/6 ## New Contributors * @LeulAria made their first contribution in https://github.com/LeulAria/volt/pull/6 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LeulAria/volt/commits/v0.0.2
